entries.zh: 谚语；格言、俗谚
entries.en: adage, proverb; saying

entries.zh: 谚云；古谚有云
entries.en: "the proverb says"; as the old adage goes

entries.zh: 谚曰；谚语说
entries.en: "the adage says"

entries.zh: 削；刮削使薄、削薄（用刀刮净）
entries.en: to pare, scrape thin; to whittle down
entries.notes: 西语 limpiando con bexuco 依马尼拉语境解作刮削藤条（bejuco）使薄净；M 栏另附一读 (bit)

entries.zh: 叠；叠置，收拾整理
entries.en: to fold or pile up; to arrange, set in order
entries.notes: M 栏另附 (tī nap) 一读，不影响释义

entries.zh: 打叠；收拾、整理（任意物件）
entries.en: to pack up, put in order (anything)

entries.zh: 修（脩）；修补，如修船
entries.en: to repair, mend (e.g. a ship)

entries.zh: 修整；修葺妥当（如船只）
entries.en: to repair and put in order, refit (as a ship)

entries.zh: 重修；翻修、大修（船或房屋）
entries.en: to repair afresh, renovate (a ship or house)

entries.zh: 煮；烹煮（备办食物）
entries.en: to boil, cook (food)

entries.zh: 烹调；烹煮调制食物
entries.en: to cook and dress (food); culinary preparation

entries.zh: 髻；女子梳绾发髻（理妆头发）
entries.en: a woman's hair-knot, chignon; to dress a woman's hair

entries.zh: 双粿；成对备办糕粿，备办得十分周到
entries.en: to prepare rice-cakes (kueh) in fine pairs; to make something very well ready
entries.notes: 汉字双粿（成对糕粿）与西语备办妥帖的对应系依待客祭祀常例推断

entries.zh: 双粿酒；备办筵席（成对糕粿与酒）
entries.en: to prepare the feast (convite): paired rice-cakes and wine
entries.notes: 双粿酒与筵席的对应依赖推断，同上条

entries.zh: 练（練）；煮练生丝，整理丝绸
entries.en: to boil and bleach (raw silk); to dress silk

entries.zh: 整修房屋（释义存疑：原字搯与音读不合）
entries.en: to put in order, repair (a house) [headword doubtful]
entries.notes: 汉字搯本义掏取，与西语整修房屋及 M/R 栏对音 chiāu、chèàu 均不合，疑原字为操／整类误写或封存件误读，待比勘

entries.zh: 伶；单字，义同伶俐——机敏俐落（与下条连读）
entries.en: clever, nimble (single syllable of the next entry, ling-li: neat and trim)
entries.notes: 单字伶的释义依托复合词伶俐推断

entries.zh: 伶俐；聪明敏捷，亦谓干净齐整、利落
entries.en: clever, sharp-witted; neat, clean, trim

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语词头栏空白；汉字嫩与官话对音 nūn 可辨，当为柔嫩之义，待比勘

entries.zh: 便；齐备、就绪，随宜方便
entries.en: ready, convenient; made ready in any manner
